priorityList.notes: Pop Combustion once Improved Scorch's debuff is fully stacked on the current target, for a guaranteed run of Fire crits. Fix round 4: tracks the engine's own debuff id (12873, sim/core/debuffs.go's ImprovedScorchAura), which the mage's own Scorch casts stack when Improved Scorch is talented (sim/mage/talents.go's applyImprovedScorch, sim/mage/scorch.go's ApplyEffects) -- restored after fix round 3 mistakenly treated this as impossible. 12873 is not in spellconst (it is an engine-side aura id, not a client spell), a known, deliberate exception for this one condition.

Scorch to apply or refresh the five stacks of Improved Scorch's debuff before it falls off. Fix round 4 restored the mechanic (see top-level notes) but left the refresh gated on a bare `or` of auraIsActive/auraNumStacks/auraRemainingTime against 12873 -- under this build's no-talent smoke run those three all fail to construct (GetAPLAura's aura.Get() is nil before the talent ever registers ImprovedScorchAura on the target), newValueOr filters every nil sub-value out of its list, and an `or` with zero surviving vals returns nil, which APLAction.IsReady reads as always-ready -- so Scorch, not 'inert', became 100% of every cast and Fire Blast/Fireball never fired once Scorch was learned. Fix round 5 wraps the same `or` in `and(auraIsKnown(12873), or(...))`: auraIsKnown (sim/core/apl_values_aura.go) never returns nil, only true/false, because it just reads whether the Aura object exists on the target rather than requiring an active instance -- and applyImprovedScorch (sim/mage/talents.go:341-343) registers that object via NewEnemyAuraArray the moment the talent is present, independent of stacks. Once the inner `or` goes nil under no talent, newValueAnd's own nil filter (same mechanism as `or`, sim/core/apl_values_operators.go) drops it and the `and` degrades to the single surviving auraIsKnown value, which is false without the talent, so the whole line is skipped and the priority list falls through to Fire Blast then Fireball -- proven with the scratch castSet at level 60 untalented.
Fire Blast on cooldown as a free extra nuke that does not compete for Scorch or Fireball casts.
Fireball is the primary filler once Improved Scorch's debuff is up.
Shoot with your wand once mana falls under 20%: it costs nothing and keeps damage going while you regenerate, and Wand Specialization adds to it.
